We see positive implications for Bizlink from Credo's comments
on expanding AEC and emerging ALC opportunities.
FY1Q27 (ended July 2026) results:
1. Credo (CRDO.US, not covered) reported revenue of US$479mn (+10% QoQ/
+115% YoY), roughly in line with the consensus of US$474mn and guidance
of US$465-475mn.
2. Non-GAAP GM was 68% (-0.3ppt QoQ) in line with consensus at 68% and
guidance at 67-69%.
3. Non-GAAP NP was US$236mn (+4% QoQ/+140% YoY), roughly in line with
consensus at US$232mn.
4. Four customers each contributed more than 10% of Credo's revenue in
FY1Q27, i.e., 33%, 28%, 13% and 10%, respectively.
FY2Q27 and FY27 outlook:
1. FY2Q27 revenue is guided to be US$525-535mn (+11% QoQ/+98% YoY at the
midpoint, largely in line with consensus of US$526mn), non-GAAP GM of 67-
69% (vs. consensus at 67.5%) and opex of US$100-105mn.
2. For FY27, Credo now expects total revenue to grow >85% YoY (vs.
consensus at ~86% YoY), with an inflection in 2H mainly from optical
revenue (>US$600mn for FY27 from Zero-Flap Optics, silicon photonics PICs
and optical DSPs, with each to contribute >US$100mn).
3. Credo expects its FY27 GM to stay flat YoY, while operating expenses might
increase by ~55% YoY.
4. 1.6T AEC might start to emerge from 2HFY27.
5. ALCs and OmniConnect gearboxes remain on track for initial revenue from
FY28, management believes both are multi-billion dollar opportunities for
Credo.
6. It also sees increasing customer activity on NPO for scale up network, with
confirmed PIC

Maintain Buy and price target of NT$3,617 (30x 2027E PE):
Based on Credo's guidance, our analysis suggests AEC sales could grow c.40% YoY and
low to mid single digit QoQ growth in FY27. The market may view Credo's QoQ growth
as a negative read-through for BizLink; however, we think BizLink could still deliver 
robust QoQ data cable sales growth in H226, given much slower shipments in H126. In 
addition, we view the ALC demonstration in Oct 2026 as a potential positive share price 
catalyst if data transmission, reliability and power efficiency prove to be a great 
interconnect solution. Bizlink is an exclusive supplier for ALC. We maintain Buy rating on 
BizLink. Besides AEC, we expect power cables, capital equipment orders from semi 
equipment customers, and factory automation to drive earnings growth by +43%/
+82% in 2026/27.

展望2H26~2027 年，受惠AI 伺服器建置需求爆發，動能由HPC 及SPE
所主導，無減速跡象，看好AEC 產品受到美系CSP 客戶拉貨積極，機櫃電
源線聚焦高功率供電，光通訊在中長距高速資料傳輸，共同支撐公司營收
動能向上，加上半導體設備營收持續成長，2027 年併購Interplex Telecom

AI機櫃功耗呈跳躍式

以及伺服器供電架構自單櫃48V進入800VDC架構，規格升級與產值
倍增。貿聯持續受惠於AI伺服器機櫃功耗、電源規格升級與高速互
連需求，公司也已與主要客戶針對未來平台進行開發，在某些領域，
甚至已逾下一代，進入N+2代解決方案的開發，使公司提早掌握客戶
需求，穩固市占率。貿聯收購新富生及Interplex Datacom，同時擁有
電源、銅線與光學領域能力，能在AI基礎建設中參與更多環節，在
單一系統中的產品內容與價值提升。我們預估2026、2027年 EPS 分
別為67.63、106.66元，基於2027預估EPS x 26倍本益比，目標價為
2,775元，維持買進之投資評等建議。

貿聯-KY 2Q26 營收 232.81 億元與 EPS 15.28 元雙創單季新高，
均優於研究部與市場預期。貿聯已由零組件供應商逐步轉型為 AI 
基礎建設整合方案供應商，隨 AI 投資重心由算力取得轉向實際
部署，其在電力、高速傳輸與精密機械的布局將持續推升單一機
櫃產值與客戶黏著度。基於：(1)銅纜有效傳輸距離隨速率提升而持
續縮短，惟在功耗與成本的權衡下 AEC 仍更具效益，滲透率可望
一路提升至 3.2T 世代；(2)機櫃功耗逐代跳升帶動電源產品規格
與單價同步成長，貿聯並參與 NVIDIA MGX 供應鏈的規格制訂；
(3)光學互連為下一階段顯著成長的應用，貿聯已切入高階光纖供
應鏈，2027 年起放量；(4)半導體設備訂單能見度已延伸至 2H27，
工廠自動化、醫療、車用與電器同步重回成長，非 AI 業務由拖累
轉為助力；(5) Interplex 併購案將補足精密機械能力，為尚未計
入預估的成長動能。研究部分別上修貿聯 2026、2027與2028 年
稀釋後 EPS 至 68.77 元（+48.9% YoY，原估 65.67 元）、117.82 
元（+71.3% YoY，原估 114.90 元）與 171.03 元（+45.2% YoY，
原估167.87元）。考量貿聯憑藉跨領域工程能力，於客戶新產品
初期即協同開發，逐代累積的認證門檻亦使後進者難以切入，產業
與供應鏈地位可望持續提升、客戶關係更趨緊密，研究部維持 2027
年 25 倍本益比評價，目標價上調至 2,950 元，維持買進投資評等。

研究員預估2026 年/2027 年營收分別來到970.8 億元
/1,539.73 億元，YoY+36.26% / 58.6%。EPS 分別為66.52 元/125.84
元，YoY+42.03% / 96.39%。過往評價區間位於15X~30X 之間，目前
評價約在2027 年的18X，考量未來仍有多項上修空間，且評價並未高
估，給予買進投資建議，目標價3,125 元(2027F 25X PE)。

目前股價交易在21.7x FY27 PER，位於參考區間10~35x 中間位置，考量
強勁成長動能延續，收購案使貿聯-KY 轉型為系統級基礎設施供應商，維持
買進投資評等，目標價2,900 元(28x FY27E PER)。

預估2026/2027年稅後EPS為67.27/104.63元，過往產業上行期貿聯本益比位
於17~31倍區間，考量併購新富生光電提升光通訊技術且正式取得訂單有利評
價上修且未來具re-rate之可能性，從2027年獲利評價，給予30倍PER。

研究部對貿聯維持積極正面評價，過去一年股價大幅增長，已初步
反映市場對其從傳統連接器廠轉型為AI 基礎建設系統級解決方案供應商的高度認
同，現在則進入一步步驗證營運成果的時刻，我們預估貿聯在未來數年仍將保持雙
位數之增長：(1) 貿聯的HPC 業務同時具備Power 與Data 雙成長引擎，且半導
體業務訂單能見度已延伸至2H27~2028 年，獲利能見度優於單一產品週期的成
長股；(2) 工業業務及其他業務的漸進式復甦提供了獲利來源的分散效果。採用
2027 年及2028 年之平均預估EPS 130.89 元為基準預估，搭配26 倍本益比作為
目標價依據，目標價調整至3,400 元，重申「買進」評等。

此次分別上修貿聯2026/2027 年EPS 3.4%/3.9%至68.35 元/113.33 元，主
因半導體設備需求優於預期，上調工業業務營收預估。我們認為貿聯毛利率
已逐漸回穩，此外，SPE 訂單能見度延伸至2H27，成為HPC 之外第二成
長動能。同時貿聯預計於2H26 完成Interplex 收購，本中心看好將擴大公司
AI 機櫃TAM，客戶與費用綜效值得關注，並提供EPS10 元以上的潛在上修
空間，因此維持貿聯買進評等，以2027 年EPS 113.33 元給予25 倍本益比，
推得目標價2,850 元。

BizLink delivered an in-line 2Q26 result with margins recovering to 30.7%,
supported by improving product mix and decent non-HPC business momentum.
While HPC was softer sequentially due to a temporary weakness in April/May, we
see trends turning better into 3Q26 on recovering data-related demand and
continued strength in power solutions, along with sustained growth in SPE on a
firmer semi capex cycle. We retain OW and fine tune our EPS by 2%/1% in
FY26/27E with an unchanged Jun-27 PT of NT$3,100, underpinned by a solid
growth trajectory from both HPC and SPE businesses.

We think the results/earnings call is a neutral event. We expect sustained strong 
earnings growth of 28% QoQ in Q326 to serve as a positive share price catalyst, 
supported by data cable shipments returning to a normal pattern, cable shipments for a 
new ASIC platform and a gross margin recovery, as utilization keeps increasing. There 
may be upside from power cables, as power sidecars could be adopted earlier. We raise 
our 2026-28E earnings 5-7% to 44%/83%/22% growth, mainly to factor in UBS latest 
view on rack shipments and ASIC shipments volumes, along with higher opex/sales. We
raise our PT from NT$3,430 to NT$3,617 (same 30x 2027E PE). We remain at Buy.

We lift 2026-28E EPS by 2-4% to reflect in-line 2Q26 results, solid AI momentum, sales 
from Interplex Datacom acquisition from 2027, and subtotal 5% 
share dilution from new GDR and ECB issued in mid-Aug. We trim PO to NT$3,088 (28x 
2027E EPS) from NT$3,230 (30x 2027E EPS), with the valuation base unchanged but a 
lower P/E multiple. We now use 28x (3SD above average) on potentially slower margin 
expansion amid clients’ different deployment schedule. Yet, we reiterate Buy as BizLink
benefits from AI copper/power/optical cable demand with volume/content increase.

We raise our 2026F/27F EPS estimates to TWD65.45/116.73 (based on outstanding
shares of 119.6mn) from TWD63.34/114.26, to factor in higher HPC sales assumption
driven by a recovery in demand for high-speed data cables and better power cabling’s
content value growth and market share, as well as non-AI segments’ growing sales. Our
market survey suggests the demand for active electrical cable (AEC) not only recovered
in 2Q26 but saw stronger order placing from a few hyperscale customers entering 2H26F.
Our 2026F/27F earnings forecasts have not taken the acquisition of Interplex into
consideration (which we believe could add 8% to 13% earnings upside to our 2027F
estimate). Our TP of TWD3,270 is based on 28x 2027F EPS of TWD116.73 (vs
TWD3,200 based on 28x 2027F EPS previously). The stock trades at 19.5x/15.3x
2027F/28F EPS (historical average of 17x since 2014).

凱基重申貿聯「增加持股」評等與12個月目標價2,850元，基於2027年
完全稀釋EPS預估的25倍 (目標本益比不變)。

We reiterate our Buy (1) call and raise our 12M TP
to TWD3,065 (from TWD3,053), based on an unchanged PER of 30x
(equal to a 0.62x PEG over 2026-28E; at the high-end of its past-3-year
range of 6-34x) applied to our 1-year forward diluted EPS forecast. Key
downside risks: weaker-than-expected orders from secular growth drivers
(HPC and semi cap) and slower-than-expected gross-margin expansion.

We focus on Bizlink's monthly sales, which we
believe could be a catalyst for its share price.
Details:
1. July sales came in at NT$9,630mn (+13% MoM/+60% YoY).
2. QTD reached 38% of both our 3Q26 estimate of NT$25,120mn (+8% QoQ/
+36% YoY) and consensus at NT$25,323mn (+9% QoQ/+38% YoY).
Our view:
1. We think its 3Q26 revenue is tracking ahead of market expectations.
2. Looking into 2H26, we expect Bizlink to see strong demand in the HPC
segment, driven by the new ASIC server model ramp and continuous AI/
general server momentum, before witnessing more dollar content upgrade
heading into 2027.
3. We remain constructive on Bizlink as an AI beneficiary, driven by its data
interconnect, power interconnect, and semiconductor equipment businesses.

轉換研究員，評等買進，目標價為3,000元，潛在漲幅35%：
1.2Q26營收符合預期，毛利率預計將回升 
2.Vera Rubin產品價值含量翻倍 
3.擴展AI業務組合

Looking ahead into 2H26, we believe the power interconnects should
continue to benefit from server rack shipment growth along with higher
dollar content from next-generation GPU servers and HVDC architecture into
2027, while data interconnects should grow with increasing AEC adoption
and spec upgrade. Moreover, Bizlink has multiple optical interconnect
offerings as well for longer-term growth. Stay OW.

BizLink reported June P&L with net profits up 61%YoY and achieving 42%/40% of
UBS/consensus Q226 net earnings estimates. We believe this is a positive read
through for its Q226 upcoming result release on August 21. Buy.

We have a Buy (1) call, with a 12-month TP of TWD3,053, based on a PER of 30x on our
1-year-forward EPS forecast. For more information on the company, please refer to our
latest memo, Record-high 2Q26 revenue slightly beat our and consensus estimates, on 6
July 2026.

維持買進評等，目標價3665 元：股價已反映1Q26 毛利率低於預期，
可視為一次性影響，Rubin、HVDC、CPO 長線故事不變，預估2026
年EPS 65.19 元，2027 年EPS 108.35 元，目標價3665 元。

We assume coverage of BizLink at OW and Jun-27 PT of NT$3,100. We forecast
an EPS CAGR of 50% during FY25-28E, driven by higher power content value,
growing optical/CPO exposure, and a robust capital equipment business on semi
capex expansion. While the stock has corrected by 36% (-43% vs TAIEX) after the
1Q26 gross margin miss, we view the margin pressure as largely transitory and
remain positive on the upcoming power product upgrades under the Vera Rubin
platform, with our FY27/28E EPS forecasts 10%/4% above consensus.

BizLink's June sales grew a robust 16% MoM, driving Q226 sales 3-4% ahead of UBS/
consensus. Maintain Buy and PT NT$3,430 (30x 2027E PE).

We remain constructive on Bizlink as an AI beneficiary, driven by its data
interconnect, power interconnect, and semiconductor equipment businesses.
Maintain OW.

We initiate and rate Bizlink (3665 TT) Buy and set our TP at NT$3,220 which is based on 28x our 2027E 
EPS estimate, or 19x 2028E EPS. We adopt 2027 as valuation basis, as the market has looked beyond 
this year and to capture its robust Power business potential with the ramp-up of optical. We adopt P/E 
methodology as we believe the market mainly focuses on the company’s earnings outlook.

貿聯持續受惠於AI資料中心電源架構升級與高速互連需求，在AI資
料中心電源業務的領先地位與長期競爭力仍具優勢，公司也透過併購
新富生、Interplex Datacom等，強化業務布局。我們預估2026、2027
年 EPS 分別為66.49、104.64元，我們基於2027預估 EPS x 26倍本
益比，目標價為2,720元，給予買進之投資評等建議。
We remain OW with PT of NT$3,665 (30x 2027e P/E).

We remain constructive on Bizlink as a beneficiary of AI, driven by data/
power interconnect and semi cap equipment businesses. Stay OW.

研究部看好貿聯可提供完整的解決方案─涵蓋高速 AEC、光通訊、
HVDC 高壓直流電源等整合，以及在機櫃層級進行熱、電、機構系統的整合，其競
爭優勢明確，其供應地位難以被取代。且AI 基礎設施升級意味著長期的工業升級
週期，同樣的互連技術也支撐著機器人、自動化與智慧製造等新興應用，未來貿聯
電力+高速傳輸解決方案將有更廣泛的應用。研究部預估2026 年至2028 年之EPS
分別為69.9、111.23 及148.75 元。本次評價採用2027 年及2028 年之平均預估
EPS 130 元為基準，以平衡2027~2028 年電力架構轉型期與CPO 爆發期之獲利
貢獻。考量其具備全面(power+data)解決方案，且在800V 高壓供電方案具備先
發優勢，且在光互連也不會缺席。給予26X 本益比，目標價3,380 元，重申「買
進」評等。雖近期因首季毛利率低於預期而造成股價下挫，研究部認為僅是短期影
響，毛利率將逐季回升。

on AEC growth and emerging ALC opportunities.
FY4Q26 (ended April 2026) results:
1. Credo (CRDO.US, not covered) reported revenue of US$437mn (+7% QoQ/
+157% YoY), consistent with consensus forecasts of US$433mn and guidance
of US$425-435mn.
2. Non-GAAP GM was 68.3% (-0.3ppt QoQ) above consensus at 65.4% and
guidance at 64-66%.
3. NP was US$227mn (+9% QoQ/+247% YoY), above consensus at US$199mn.
4. Four customers each contributed more than 10% of Credo's revenue in
FY4Q26, i.e., 34%, 27%, 16% and 10%, respectively.
FY1Q27 and FY27 outlook:
1. FY1Q27 revenue is guided to be US$465-475mn (+8% QoQ/+111% YoY at the
midpoint, above consensus of US$460mn), non-GAAP GM of 67-69% (vs.
consensus at 65%) and opex of US$86-90mn.
2. For FY27, Credo expects total revenue to grow >80% YoY (vs. consensus at
65-70% YoY), with mid-single-digit % sequential growth in 1Q/2Q mostly on
AEC and a significant inflection in 2H mainly from optical revenue (>US

DSPs).
3. Credo expects GM to stay largely consistent YoY, while operating expenses
are set to grow ~50% YoY.
4. Customer mix will become less concentrated, as it continues to diversify
among CSPs and neocloud customers (neoclouds to make up 20% of
revenue in the coming years).
5. Credo expects AEC adoption to broaden, with some scale-up revenue
emerging in FY27, becoming more substantial in FY28.
6. ALCs and

1. GM trajectory: 1Q26 GM of 28.8% (-3.2ppt QoQ) will likely be temporary as the
impact of a less favorable revenue mix in the HPC business should be alleviated in
the coming quarters amid the new model ramp. Management stays positive on the
full-year GM and earnings outlooks.
2. Content value for power interconnects: On top of overall server shipment
growth, power interconnects should continue to benefit from the higher power
density of server racks and (more meaningfully) the Vera Rubin generation, as well

3. Optical business: Bizlink has strengthened its capabilities in the optical space
following the acquisition of XFS in early 2026. We expect it to leverage customer

should come in 2028.

此次下修貿聯2026 年EPS 6%，主因AEC 高階產品比重低於預期，下調毛
利率預估；上調2027 年EPS 7%，主因工業及車用優於預期，上調營收預
估。我們認為貿聯股價已反映1Q26 產品組合不利因素，並看好高階AEC
拉貨動能將回升，隨GPU 密度提升帶動機櫃短距互連需求，AEC 滲透率仍
具高成長空間，並逐步往800G/1.6T 升級長期趨勢不變，因此維持貿聯買進
評等，以2027 年EPS 110.21 元、25 倍本益比，推得目標價2,800 元。

凱基重申貿聯「增加持股」評等與12個月目標價2,600元，基於2027年
完全稀釋EPS預估的25倍 (目標本益比不變)。我們認為短期不利因素提供
進場良機，建議股價逢回布局。

貿聯-KY 1Q26 EPS 為 11.66 元，低於研究部與市場預期，主要受到資料
傳輸新舊產品轉換、產品組合轉差、原物料成本高檔及工作天數較少影響，
使毛利率降至 28.8%，大幅低於原先預期；惟研究部認為，此次屬平台轉
換期間的一次性影響，並非 AI 需求轉弱或公司長期競爭力惡化。展望後
續，隨 2Q26 起新一代資料傳輸產品逐步放量、電源傳輸業務持續成長、

分析能力與真實世界臨床場域，形成可持續學習與優化的健康數據飛輪（Data Flywheel）。透過集團內部自主研發的 AI 健康智能體（Health Agents），結合長期追蹤建立的數據資料，AI 貿聯、光寶科 兩檔靚

台股近期雖因美國經濟數據等影響，行情趨於震盪，但具基本面支撐、且法人看好未來營運展望的貿聯-KY（3665）、光寶科（2301）等個股成為市場焦點，投資人可運用資金門檻低的相關認購權證，參與個股走勢。貿聯-KY產品開發策略著重多角化及差異化，INBG加入後，將增強產品組合的附加價值，提升歐美據點在地市占、區域互補等效應。今年初完成收購新富生光電，其在資料中心的光纖跳線居業界領先地位，將強化貿聯於CPO等關鍵技術領域中扮演重要角色。受惠AI算力密度攀升，貿聯-KY出貨規格也持續升級，挹注營運。法人圈對貿聯維持積極正面評價，主因其在AI伺服器基礎設施的規格升級路徑中，具備全面解決方案的供應地位，且隨著單機功耗從Blackwell至Vera Rubin世代，以及在800V HVDC架構下的系統級供應能力，使貿聯單機產值持續大幅增長；同時，透過收購新富生切入康寧光通訊供應鏈，更確保未來在CPO趨勢中的先發優勢，市場預估今、明年每股純益（EPS）將分別成長至69.9元、111.2元。光寶科在第2季營運展望上，隨著8.5kW PSU/BBU、33KW/110KW 機架式電源（PowerShelf）等產品出貨，市場看好雲端業務部門成長強勁；IT部分，隨著記憶體等原物料到貨，遊戲機恢復供貨，再加上資通訊產品提前出貨，市場上修單季營收至523億元，季增20.6%，毛利率因產品組合轉佳，預估約23.4%，上修EPS至2元。看好貿聯-KY、光寶科後市表現的投資人，可挑選價內外15%以內、有效天期三個月以上的權證介入。
